Source bytes alone cannot identify a checker which delegates to native images.
This module records both the reviewed Python dependency closure and the actual
immutable mappings returned by the existing native loaders. Some loaders
initialize their fixed table or transport emitter; identity capture does not
invoke a business-policy entry or treat a digest as a correctness theorem.
The host Python/loader and absence of hostile process mutation remain assumed.
"""

@dataclass(frozen=True, eq=False)
class HeldNativeOwner:
    """Actual immutable mapping and exact bytes from one admitted selection.

    This in-process capability is never reconstructed from proof evidence.
    Cached mappings can be shared by several independent admission records;
    their manifest/source bytes must not overwrite one another on the image.
    """
    selector: str
    image: object
    manifest: bytes
    source: bytes


def _held_manifest_pairs(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError("duplicate held native manifest field")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _held_native_identity(binding):
    if type(binding) is not HeldNativeOwner:
        raise ValueError("held checker owner requires its admitted in-process capability")
    if type(binding.selector) is not str:
        raise ValueError("held checker selector must be an exact string")
    if binding.selector in HELD_NATIVE_OWNERS:
        if binding.selector in NATIVE_OWNERS or binding.selector in CAPTURED_NATIVE_OWNERS:
            raise ValueError("service-held checker owner overlaps an ordinary selector")
        module_name, factory_name = HELD_NATIVE_OWNERS[binding.selector]
    elif binding.selector in CAPTURED_NATIVE_OWNERS:
        record = CAPTURED_NATIVE_OWNERS[binding.selector]
        if (binding.selector not in NATIVE_OWNERS or type(record) is not tuple
                or len(record) != 4 or any(type(part) is not str for part in record)):
            raise ValueError("captured checker type is outside its reviewed ordinary owner")
        module_name, factory_name = record[2:]
    else:
        raise ValueError("held checker owner is outside the explicit capability inventory")
    module = importlib.import_module("." + module_name, __package__)
    if type(binding.image) is not getattr(module, factory_name):
        raise ValueError("held checker mapping differs from its native owner type")
    if (type(binding.manifest) is not bytes or not 0 < len(binding.manifest) <= 16384
            or type(binding.source) is not bytes or not 0 < len(binding.source) <= 8 << 20):
        raise ValueError("held checker admission does not retain exact bounded input bytes")
    record = json.loads(binding.manifest, object_pairs_hook=_held_manifest_pairs)
    fields = {"schema", "source_sha256", "image_path", "image_sha256", "compiler_sha256"}
    if (type(record) is not dict or set(record) != fields or record["schema"] != module.SCHEMA
            or any(type(record[name]) is not str or len(record[name]) != 64
                   or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in record[name])
                   for name in ("source_sha256", "image_sha256", "compiler_sha256"))):
        raise ValueError("held checker manifest differs from its admitted schema")
    image_name = record["image_path"]
    if (type(image_name) is not str or not image_name or image_name in (".", "..")
            or any(ord(char) < 32 for char in image_name) or Path(image_name).name != image_name):
        raise ValueError("held checker image must have its admitted sibling basename")
    mapped = _mapped_identity(binding.image)
    source_sha256 = sha256(binding.source).hexdigest()
    if mapped["image_sha256"] != record["image_sha256"] or source_sha256 != record["source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("held checker bytes differ from their admitted identity")
    return {"manifest_sha256": sha256(binding.manifest).hexdigest(), "schema": record["schema"],
            "sources": {"image": source_sha256}, "images": {"image": mapped}, "child_manifests": {}}


def hold_native_owner(selector, image, manifest, source):
    """Retain one already-admitted mapping without rereading mutable paths."""
    binding = HeldNativeOwner(selector, image, manifest, source)
    _held_native_identity(binding)
    return binding


def checker_source_identity(extra_files=()):
    """Freshly hash the generated full custody closure plus consumer inputs."""
    if CHECKER_CUSTODY_GENERATED is not True:
        raise ValueError("checker custody inventory has not been generated and verified")
    names = set(CORE_SOURCE_FILES) | set(MECHANISM_SOURCE_FILES) | set(extra_files)
    return {name: sha256(Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for name in sorted(names)}


def _manifest_bytes(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read(65537)
    if len(raw) > 65536:
        raise ValueError("checker native manifest exceeds its fixed identity bound")
    return raw


def _mapped_identity(image):
    # A cached immutable image can intentionally survive replacement of its
    # backing file. Identify that loaded mapping, not whatever now occupies the
    # old pathname. The existing loader performs all schema and source checks.
    from .hia_json_preflight_native import NativeHiaJsonImage, MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
    if not isinstance(image, NativeHiaJsonImage):
        raise ValueError("checker owner did not return its native image")
    raw = image._mapping[:]
    if not 0 < len(raw) <= MAX_IMAGE_BYTES or sha256(raw).hexdigest() != image.image_sha256:
        raise ValueError("checker native mapping differs from its loaded identity")
    return {"image_sha256": image.image_sha256, "image_bytes": len(raw)}


def _capture_selected_owners():
    """Observe capabilities without reading a manifest or admitting a family."""
    captured = {}
    for key, record in CAPTURED_NATIVE_OWNERS.items():
        if (key not in NATIVE_OWNERS or key in HELD_NATIVE_OWNERS
                or type(record) is not tuple or len(record) != 4
                or any(type(part) is not str for part in record)):
            raise ValueError("captured checker hook is outside the reviewed owner inventory")
        module = importlib.import_module("." + record[0], __package__)
        observation = getattr(module, record[1])()
        if (type(observation) is not tuple or len(observation) != 2
                or type(observation[0]) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("captured checker owner observation is malformed")
        if observation[0]:
            binding = observation[1]
            if binding is not None and (type(binding) is not HeldNativeOwner or binding.selector != key):
                raise ValueError("captured checker owner differs from its declared selector")
            captured[key] = binding
        elif observation[1] is not None:
            raise ValueError("uncaptured checker owner supplied a capability")
    for key in BUNDLE_NATIVE_OWNERS:
        if key not in NATIVE_OWNERS or key in CAPTURED_NATIVE_OWNERS or key in HELD_NATIVE_OWNERS:
            raise ValueError("bundle checker inventory overlaps a different capability role")
        scoped, owner = _bundle_capture(key)
        if scoped:
            captured[key] = owner
    return captured


def _family_capture(captured, selected):
    """Use the same read-only scope observation as the public family routers."""
    from .hia_backend_family_selection import (
        lowering_family, emitter_family, plan_family, elf_family)
    from .hia_byte_policy_selection import _requested_family
    observations = []
    for router in (lowering_family, emitter_family, plan_family, elf_family):
        observed = router.observe()
        if (type(observed) is not tuple or len(observed) != 3
                or type(observed[0]) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("checker native family scope observation is malformed")
        scoped, family, owner = observed
        primary, control = router.bundle_selector, router.control_selector
        if primary not in NATIVE_OWNERS or control not in NATIVE_OWNERS:
            raise ValueError("checker native family is not in the fixed owner inventory")
        observations.append((router, observed))
        if not scoped:
            if family is not None or owner is not None or primary in captured or control in captured:
                raise ValueError("uncaptured checker family supplied a capability")
            if selected[primary] and selected[control]:
                raise ValueError("checker native family requires one explicit selection")
            continue
        if family is None:
            if owner is not None or any(captured.get(key) is not None for key in (primary, control)):
                raise ValueError("captured absent family supplied a native owner")
            captured[primary] = captured[control] = None
            continue
        if family not in (router.primary_family, "control") or owner is None:
            raise ValueError("captured checker family tag is outside its exact protocol")
        key, other = (primary, control) if family == router.primary_family else (control, primary)
        binding = captured.get(key)
        actual = binding if key in BUNDLE_NATIVE_OWNERS else (
            binding.image if type(binding) is HeldNativeOwner else None)
        if actual is not owner or captured.get(other) is not None:
            raise ValueError("captured checker family differs from the actual public route")
        # A directly entered single-family scope masks the other ambient
        # selector exactly as _FamilySelection._captured does.
        captured[other] = None
    byte_primary, byte_control = "HEPTA_HIA_BYTE_WRAPPER_MANIFEST", "HEPTA_HIA_NATIVE_BYTE_ABI_MANIFEST"
    requested = _requested_family()
    present = {key: (captured[key] is not None if key in captured else bool(selected[key]))
               for key in (byte_primary, byte_control)}
    if present[byte_primary] and present[byte_control]:
        raise ValueError("checker byte families cannot both be selected")
    expected = "bundle" if present[byte_primary] else "control" if present[byte_control] else None
    if requested != expected:
        raise ValueError("checker byte-family selection changed before admission")
    return tuple(observations)


STRICT_EMPTY_NATIVE_SELECTORS = (
    "HEPTA_HIA_EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_MANIFEST",
    "HEPTA_HIA_CORE_ADMISSION_MANIFEST",
    "HEPTA_HIA_INSTRUCTION_POLICY_MANIFEST",
)


def checker_native_selection(*, held_owners=()):
    """Bind the actual semantic checker owners, never a serialized authority.

    Physical dependency declarations are separately inventoried. Their mere
    presence in a source file is not a claim that the checker dispatched them.
    """
    if type(held_owners) is not tuple:
        raise ValueError("held checker owners must be an explicit immutable capability tuple")
    captured = _capture_selected_owners()
    selected_raw = {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in sorted(NATIVE_OWNERS)}
    selected = {key: path or None for key, path in selected_raw.items()}
    family_observations = _family_capture(captured, selected)
    for key in STRICT_EMPTY_NATIVE_SELECTORS:
        if key not in captured and selected_raw[key] == "":
            raise ValueError("native checker selector must not be empty: " + key)
    result = {}
    for key, path in selected.items():
        if key in captured:
            binding = captured[key]
            result[key] = (None if binding is None else
                           _bundle_identity(key, binding) if key in BUNDLE_NATIVE_OWNERS else
                           _held_native_identity(binding))
            continue
        if path is None:
            result[key] = None
            continue
        if key in BUNDLE_NATIVE_OWNERS:
            # Original loaders retain original admission order and warm RX
            # semantics. This new observer adds no image-file reread.
            result[key] = _bundle_identity(key, _admit_bundle(key, path))
            continue
        module_name, loader_name = NATIVE_OWNERS[key]
        module = importlib.import_module("." + module_name, __package__)
        raw = _manifest_bytes(path)
        sources = ({"image": module.SOURCE} if hasattr(module, "SOURCE") else module.SOURCES)
        source_identity = {name: sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                           for name, source in sorted(sources.items())}
        children = {}
        if hasattr(module, "SOURCES"):
            value = json.loads(raw)
            children = {name: _manifest_bytes(Path(path).parent / component)
                        for name, component in sorted(value["kernels"].items())}
        owner = getattr(module, loader_name)(path)
        images = {"image": owner} if hasattr(owner, "_mapping") else owner.images
        if set(images) != set(sources):
            raise ValueError("checker native image/source inventory differs")
        image_identity = {name: _mapped_identity(image) for name, image in sorted(images.items())}
        if hasattr(owner, "images"):
            if children != {name: _manifest_bytes(Path(path).parent / component)
                            for name, component in sorted(value["kernels"].items())}:
                raise ValueError("checker child manifest changed during identity capture")
        if (raw != _manifest_bytes(path)
                or source_identity != {name: sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                                       for name, source in sorted(sources.items())}):
            raise ValueError("checker native manifest/source changed during identity capture")
        result[key] = {"manifest_sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "schema": module.SCHEMA,
                       "sources": source_identity, "images": image_identity,
                       "child_manifests": {name: sha256(child).hexdigest()
                                           for name, child in children.items()}}
    if ({key: path for key, path in selected_raw.items() if key not in captured}
            != {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in sorted(NATIVE_OWNERS) if key not in captured}):
        raise ValueError("checker native selection changed during identity capture")
    for router, prior in family_observations:
        current = router.observe()
        if (type(current) is not tuple or len(current) != 3
                or current[:2] != prior[:2] or current[2] is not prior[2]):
            raise ValueError("checker captured family changed during identity capture")
    for binding in held_owners:
        identity = _held_native_identity(binding)
        if binding.selector in result:
            raise ValueError("held checker selection repeats or overrides an ambient owner")
        result[binding.selector] = identity
    return result


def require_bound_checker_owner(selector, binding):
    """A selected consumer must supply its real capability, never JSON evidence."""
    if type(selector) is not str:
        raise ValueError("checker consumer selector must be exact text")
    if selector in BUNDLE_NATIVE_OWNERS:
        return _bundle_identity(selector, binding)
    if selector not in NATIVE_OWNERS and selector not in HELD_NATIVE_OWNERS:
        raise ValueError("native provider is outside the checker's semantic owner inventory")
    if type(binding) is not HeldNativeOwner or binding.selector != selector:
        raise ValueError("selected checker consumer has no matching native capability")
    return _held_native_identity(binding)


def checker_digest(extra_files=()):
    identity = {"source_identity": checker_source_identity(extra_files),
                "native_selection": checker_native_selection()}
    return sha256(json.dumps(identity, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()

"""Explicit Linux startup/stdin/stdout/stderr profile; it is never an ordinary Core authority.

This module extends the *actual* typed instruction and loan checker. It does not
replace an I/O instruction by a call to a fabricated function. The VM receives a
caller-supplied finite physical-effect provider; importing or verifying this
profile does not bind Python's file descriptors. Native construction is a
separate HIA-compiler/HIA-ELF-packer operation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from hashlib import sha256
from types import MappingProxyType

from .hia_opcodes import EFFECTS, OpcodeSpec
from .hia_program import (
    HIAProgramRejected, _decode, _reference_primitive_structure,
    _function_interfaces, _verify_function,
)
from .hia_schema import SCHEMA_V8

PROFILE = "hepta.hia.linux-process.v1"
MODULE = "selfhost_linux_process"
PROFILE_SOURCE_FILES = (
    "examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost_linux_process.hepta",
    "examples/hia_bootstrap/linux_process_entry_packer.hepta",
)
SOURCE_LIMIT = OUTPUT_LIMIT = WORKSPACE_LIMIT = 1048576
FUNCTION_LIMIT = 128
BLOCK_LIMIT = 1536
INSTRUCTION_LIMIT = 8192
READ = "linux.stdin.read"
WRITE = "linux.stdout.write"
STDERR = "linux.stderr.write"
STARTUP_EFFECT = "linux_startup"
PROFILE_EFFECTS = EFFECTS | {"linux_io", STARTUP_EFFECT}
IO_OPCODES = MappingProxyType({
    READ: OpcodeSpec(READ, ("mutbuf", "usize", "usize"), ("i64",),
                     effects=("linux_io", "write", "trap"), traps=("bounds",),
                     since=8, guards=("write:0",),
                     semantic_rule="single_linux_read_fd0_raw_signed_result"),
    WRITE: OpcodeSpec(WRITE, ("view", "usize", "usize"), ("i64",),
                      effects=("linux_io", "read", "trap"), traps=("bounds",),
                      since=8, guards=("read:0",),
                      semantic_rule="single_linux_write_fd1_raw_signed_result"),
    STDERR: OpcodeSpec(STDERR, ("view", "usize", "usize"), ("i64",),
                       effects=("linux_io", "read", "trap"), traps=("bounds",),
                       since=8, guards=("read:0",),
                       semantic_rule="single_linux_write_fd2_raw_signed_result"),
})
STARTUP_OPCODES = MappingProxyType({
    **{name: OpcodeSpec(name, (), ("usize",),
        effects=(STARTUP_EFFECT, "read", "trap"), traps=("bounds",), since=8,
        semantic_rule="immutable_kernel_startup_ordered_count")
       for name in ("linux.argv.count", "linux.env.count")},
    **{name: OpcodeSpec(name, ("usize",), ("usize",),
        effects=(STARTUP_EFFECT, "read", "trap"), traps=("bounds",), since=8,
        semantic_rule="immutable_kernel_startup_raw_string_length")
       for name in ("linux.argv.length", "linux.env.length")},
    **{name: OpcodeSpec(name, ("mutbuf", "usize", "usize", "usize", "usize"), ("usize",),
        effects=(STARTUP_EFFECT, "read", "write", "trap"), traps=("bounds",),
        since=8, guards=("write:0",),
        semantic_rule="immutable_kernel_startup_bounded_raw_string_copy")
       for name in ("linux.argv.copy", "linux.env.copy")},
})
PROFILE_OPCODES = MappingProxyType({**IO_OPCODES, **STARTUP_OPCODES})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LinuxStartupSnapshot:
    """Explicit immutable VM reference data; never a native kernel capability."""

    argv: tuple[bytes, ...]
    environment: tuple[bytes, ...]


def _checked_startup(snapshot):
    if type(snapshot) is not LinuxStartupSnapshot:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("an explicit reference startup snapshot is required",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_STARTUP")
    for values in (snapshot.argv, snapshot.environment):
        if (type(values) is not tuple or any(type(value) is not bytes or b"\x00" in value
                                             for value in values)):
            raise HIAProgramRejected("ordered immutable NUL-free startup byte strings required",
                                     "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_STARTUP")
    # Do not collapse duplicates, decode bytes, select environment names or add
    # the existing 1MiB per-buffer ceiling to the total kernel-startup domain.
    return LinuxStartupSnapshot(snapshot.argv, snapshot.environment)



def profile_resource_path(name):
    """Resolve one declared build asset in this checkout or installed package.

    Missing installed assets never fall back to another checkout, cwd or HOME.
    Resolving a path grants no compiler, cold, execution or default authority.
    """
    if type(name) is not str or name not in PROFILE_SOURCE_FILES:
        raise ValueError("an exact declared Linux stdio build resource is required")
    from .hia_json_preflight_native import _source_resource_path
    return _source_resource_path(name)


def require_profile(profile):
    if type(profile) is not str or profile != PROFILE:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("an exact explicit Linux stdio profile is required",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_PROFILE")


def profile_effects(profile):
    require_profile(profile)
    return PROFILE_EFFECTS


def profile_opcode(profile, opcode, schema):
    require_profile(profile)
    if schema != SCHEMA_V8:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("Linux stdio requires explicit primitive v8",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_PROFILE")
    return PROFILE_OPCODES.get(opcode)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VerifiedLinuxProcessProgram:
    """Detached bytes only. All consumers recheck; this is not VerifiedProgram."""

    canonical_bytes: bytes

    def as_dict(self):
        if type(self.canonical_bytes) is not bytes:
            raise HIAProgramRejected("profile bytes must be immutable", "E_HIA_FORMAT")
        return _decode(self.canonical_bytes)[0]

    @property
    def sha256(self):
        return sha256(self.canonical_bytes).hexdigest()

    @property
    def input_sha256(self):
        return self.sha256

    def report(self):
        checked = verify_linux_process_program(self)
        doc = checked.as_dict()
        return {"schema": "hepta.hia.linux-process-verification.v1", "profile": PROFILE,
                "program_sha256": checked.sha256,
                "functions_checked": len(doc["functions"]),
                "blocks_checked": sum(len(f["blocks"]) for f in doc["functions"]),
                "operations_checked": sum(len(b["ops"]) for f in doc["functions"]
                                           for b in f["blocks"]),
                "typed_closed_ssa_checked": True,
                "linear_resources_and_loan_provenance_checked": True,
                "fixed_descriptors": {READ: 0, WRITE: 1, STDERR: 2},
                "startup_reference_is_native_authority": False,
                "default_core_authority": False, "kernel_authority": False,
                "native_artifact_created": False, "matching_cold": False,
                "whole": False}


def verify_linux_process_program(program):
    if type(program) is VerifiedLinuxProcessProgram:
        if type(program.canonical_bytes) is not bytes:
            raise HIAProgramRejected("profile bytes must be immutable", "E_HIA_FORMAT")
        program = program.canonical_bytes
    data, raw = _decode(program)
    if (type(data) is not dict or data.get("schema") != SCHEMA_V8
            or data.get("module") != MODULE):
        raise HIAProgramRejected("explicit primitive v8 Linux stdio module required",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_PROFILE")
    functions, blocks = _reference_primitive_structure(data, profile=PROFILE)
    if (len(functions) > FUNCTION_LIMIT
            or sum(len(v) for v in blocks.values()) > BLOCK_LIMIT
            or sum(len(b["ops"]) for f in functions.values()
                   for b in f["blocks"]) > INSTRUCTION_LIMIT):
        raise HIAProgramRejected("original selfhost structural limits exceeded", "E_HIA_LIMIT")
    entry = data["functions"][0]
    if (entry["name"] != "f0"
            or [p["type"] for p in entry["params"]] != ["readbuf", "mutbuf", "mutbuf"]
            or entry["returns"] != ["u32"]):
        raise HIAProgramRejected("Linux stdio uses the original f0 three-buffer ABI",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_ABI")
    interfaces = _function_interfaces(functions)
    for fn in functions.values():
        _verify_function(data["schema"], fn, blocks[fn["name"]], interfaces, profile=PROFILE)
    return VerifiedLinuxProcessProgram(raw)


def assemble_linux_process(source):
    from .hia_agent_assembly import _source, _parse_assembly_document
    raw, _ = _source(source)
    if len(raw) > SOURCE_LIMIT:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("Linux stdio source exceeds 1 MiB", "E_HIA_LIMIT")
    return verify_linux_process_program(_parse_assembly_document(raw))


def render_linux_process(program):
    from .hia_agent_assembly import _render_assembly_document
    checked = verify_linux_process_program(program)
    rendered = _render_assembly_document(checked.as_dict())
    if len(rendered.encode("utf-8")) > SOURCE_LIMIT:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("Linux stdio source exceeds 1 MiB", "E_HIA_LIMIT")
    if assemble_linux_process(rendered).canonical_bytes != checked.canonical_bytes:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("profile rendering changed verified bytes",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_ROUNDTRIP")
    return rendered


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LinuxProcessRequest:
    operation: str
    fd: int
    offset: int
    count: int
    extent: int
    write_bytes: bytes


class LinuxProcessProviderRejected(ValueError):
    """The supplied observation is outside one fixed Linux I/O result."""


class LinuxProcessSignal(Exception):
    """An explicit reference-provider signal, never an implicit OS action."""

    def __init__(self, number):
        if type(number) is not int or not 1 <= number <= 64:
            raise ValueError("exact Linux signal number required")
        self.number = number
        super().__init__(number)


def _execute(checked, function, buffers, provider, startup, *, max_steps, max_heap_bytes,
             allocation_fail_at, max_call_depth):
    from .hia_program_runtime import (
        _Machine, _Owner, _View, _underlying, HIAProgramTrap, HIAProgramBudgetExceeded,
    )

    class LinuxProcessMachine(_Machine):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__(checked, max_steps, max_heap_bytes, allocation_fail_at, max_call_depth)
            self.effects = []

        def operation(self, ins, env, depth):
            operation = ins["op"]
            if operation in STARTUP_OPCODES:
                values = startup.argv if operation.startswith("linux.argv.") else startup.environment
                kind = operation.rsplit(".", 1)[1]
                args = [env[name] for name in ins["args"]]
                if kind == "count":
                    result = len(values)
                    event = {"operation": operation, "result": result}
                else:
                    index = args[0] if kind == "length" else args[2]
                    if type(index) is not int or index < 0 or index >= len(values):
                        raise HIAProgramTrap("bounds", "startup string index is outside the selected vector")
                    raw = values[index]
                    if kind == "length":
                        result = len(raw)
                        event = {"operation": operation, "index": index, "result": result}
                    else:
                        view, destination, _, offset, count = args
                        if (type(view) is not _View or not view.mutable
                                or any(type(v) is not int or v < 0 for v in (destination, offset, count))):
                            raise HIAProgramRejected("invalid startup copy capability",
                                                     "E_HIA_RUNTIME_INVARIANT")
                        owner = _underlying(view)
                        # Same order as the native primitive: selected string,
                        # source offset/count, then destination offset/count.
                        if offset > len(raw) or count > len(raw) - offset:
                            raise HIAProgramTrap("bounds", "startup copy exceeds its source string")
                        if destination > len(owner.data) or count > len(owner.data) - destination:
                            raise HIAProgramTrap("bounds", "startup copy exceeds its destination borrow")
                        payload = raw[offset:offset + count]
                        owner.data[destination:destination + count] = payload
                        result = count
                        event = {"operation": operation, "index": index, "offset": offset,
                                 "destination": destination, "count": count, "result": result,
                                 "copied_hex": payload.hex()}
                self.effects.append({**event, "status": "returned", "reference_snapshot": True})
                env[ins["out"][0]["name"]] = result
                return
            if operation not in IO_OPCODES:
                return super().operation(ins, env, depth)
            view, offset, count = (env[name] for name in ins["args"])
            owner = _underlying(view)
            if (type(view) is not _View or operation == READ and not view.mutable
                    or type(offset) is not int or type(count) is not int
                    or offset < 0 or count < 0):
                raise HIAProgramRejected("invalid typed physical effect borrow",
                                         "E_HIA_RUNTIME_INVARIANT")
            extent = len(owner.data)
            # Match generated native code: prove offset first, then subtract.
            if offset > extent or count > extent - offset:
                raise HIAProgramTrap("bounds", "physical I/O exceeds the borrowed extent")
            request = LinuxProcessRequest(operation, {READ: 0, WRITE: 1, STDERR: 2}[operation],
                offset, count, extent,
                bytes(owner.data[offset:offset + count]) if operation != READ else b"")
            row = {"operation": operation, "fd": request.fd, "offset": offset,
                   "count": count, "extent": extent, "write_hex": request.write_bytes.hex(),
                   "status": "issued"}
            self.effects.append(row)
            try:
                response = provider(request)
            except BaseException:
                row["status"] = "provider_raised"
                raise
            if (type(response) is not tuple or len(response) != 2
                    or type(response[0]) is not int or type(response[1]) is not bytes):
                raise LinuxProcessProviderRejected("exact integer/bytes response required")
            result, payload = response
            if (not -4095 <= result <= count or result < 0 and payload
                    or operation != READ and payload
                    or operation == READ and len(payload) != max(0, result)):
                raise LinuxProcessProviderRejected("response outside one Linux I/O observation")
            # No mutation happens before the complete provider result is admitted.
            row.update(status="returned", result=result, read_hex=payload.hex())
            if operation == READ and result > 0:
                owner.data[offset:offset + result] = payload
            env[ins["out"][0]["name"]] = result

    roots = tuple(_Owner(-(i + 1), bytearray(raw)) for i, raw in enumerate(buffers))
    arguments = [_View(roots[0], False), _View(roots[1], True), _View(roots[2], True)]
    machine = LinuxProcessMachine()

    def observation(status, values=None, error=None):
        result = machine.report(function, status, values, error, external_roots=roots)
        result.update(schema="hepta.hia.linux-process-execution.v1", profile=PROFILE,
            source_hex=roots[0].data.hex(), output_hex=roots[1].data.hex(),
            workspace_hex=roots[2].data.hex(), effects=machine.effects,
            explicit_effect_provider=True, actual_kernel_execution=False,
            default_core_authority=False, matching_cold=False, whole=False)
        return result

    try:
        values = machine.invoke(machine.functions[function], arguments)
    except HIAProgramTrap as exc:
        exc.report = observation("trapped", error=exc)
        raise
    except HIAProgramBudgetExceeded as exc:
        exc.report = observation("budget_exceeded", error=exc)
        raise
    except (LinuxProcessSignal, LinuxProcessProviderRejected) as exc:
        # These are profile-owned reference outcomes, not ordinary Core traps
        # or a claim that a real kernel signal/provider was observed.
        exc.report = {"schema": "hepta.hia.linux-process-external-outcome.v1",
            "profile": PROFILE, "program_sha256": checked.sha256,
            "status": "external_signal" if type(exc) is LinuxProcessSignal else "provider_refused",
            "signal": exc.number if type(exc) is LinuxProcessSignal else None,
            "steps": machine.steps, "resources": machine.resources(),
            "source_hex": roots[0].data.hex(), "output_hex": roots[1].data.hex(),
            "workspace_hex": roots[2].data.hex(), "effects": machine.effects,
            "actual_kernel_execution": False, "matching_cold": False, "whole": False}
        raise
    except RecursionError as exc:
        limit = HIAProgramBudgetExceeded("calls", "host recursion limit reached")
        limit.report = observation("budget_exceeded", error=limit)
        raise limit from exc
    if machine.owners or machine.chains or machine.loans_started != machine.loans_ended:
        raise HIAProgramRejected("profile return retains local resources", "E_HIA_RUNTIME_INVARIANT")
    return observation("returned", values)


def execute_linux_process(program, function, arguments, *, provider, startup,
                        max_steps=1000000, max_heap_bytes=16 * 1024 * 1024,
                        allocation_fail_at=None, max_call_depth=256):
    checked = verify_linux_process_program(program)
    startup = _checked_startup(startup)
    if (type(function) is not str or function != "f0"
            or type(arguments) not in (list, tuple) or not callable(provider)
            or type(max_steps) is not int or not 1 <= max_steps <= 10000000
            or type(max_heap_bytes) is not int or not 0 <= max_heap_bytes <= 1024 * 1024 * 1024
            or type(max_call_depth) is not int or not 1 <= max_call_depth <= 256
            or allocation_fail_at is not None
               and (type(allocation_fail_at) is not int or allocation_fail_at < 1)):
        raise HIAProgramRejected("invalid profile boundary/provider/limits", "E_HIA_INPUT")
    buffers = tuple(arguments)
    if len(buffers) != 3 or any(type(raw) is not bytes or len(raw) > SOURCE_LIMIT for raw in buffers):
        raise HIAProgramRejected("three exact immutable buffers, at most 1 MiB each, required",
                                 "E_HIA_LINUX_PROCESS_ABI")
    return _execute(checked, function, buffers, provider, startup, max_steps=max_steps,
        max_heap_bytes=max_heap_bytes, allocation_fail_at=allocation_fail_at,
        max_call_depth=max_call_depth)

"""Independent kernel/VM observers for explicitly selected process-profile ELFs.

Python/ctypes only arrange execve's raw byte vectors in the child before exec.
The executed static ELF has no interpreter, Python, libc or ctypes dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import ctypes
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')


LIMITS = {'wall': 20, 'cleanup': 3, 'cpu': 10, 'address': 256 << 20,
          'stack': 8 << 20, 'filesize': 16 << 20, 'fds': 32, 'core': 0}


def raw_exec(specification):
    """Run only as a fresh pre-exec helper; no profile code runs in this process."""
    spec = json.loads(Path(specification).read_text())
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    lib.execve.argtypes = (ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p),
                          ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p))
    lib.execve.restype = ctypes.c_int
    arrays = []
    retained = []
    for kind in ('argv_hex', 'environment_hex'):
        values = tuple(bytes.fromhex(s) for s in spec[kind])
        assert all(b'\0' not in value for value in values)
        retained.extend(values)
        array = (ctypes.c_char_p * (len(values) + 1))()
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            array[i] = value
        array[len(values)] = None
        arrays.append(array)
    image = Path(spec['elf']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(image) == spec['elf_sha256']
    for kind, size in ((resource.RLIMIT_CORE, 0), (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, 10),
            (resource.RLIMIT_AS, 256 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_STACK, 8 << 20),
            (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, 16 << 20), (resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, 32)):
        resource.setrlimit(kind, (size, size))
    signal.signal(signal.SIGPIPE, signal.SIG_IGN if spec['sigpipe_ignored'] else signal.SIG_DFL)
    for fd in spec['close_fds']:
        os.close(fd)
    result = lib.execve(os.fsencode(spec['elf']), arrays[0], arrays[1])
    error = ctypes.get_errno()
    # This distinct file records a failure before payload entry, even when fd2
    # deliberately closed/broken. Never relabel it as a HIA program outcome.
    dump(Path(spec['exec_failure']), {'returncode': result, 'errno': error,
        'payload_entered': False, 'stage': 'raw_execve'})
    os._exit(125)


def direct(folder, elf, argv, environment, *, stdin=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False):
    folder.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    assert type(argv) is tuple and type(environment) is tuple
    assert all(type(x) is bytes and b'\0' not in x for x in argv + environment)
    raw = elf.read_bytes()
    (folder / 'stdin.bin').write_bytes(stdin)
    closed = {'closed-stdin': [0], 'closed-stdout': [1], 'closed-stderr': [2]}.get(mode, [])
    spec = {'elf': str(elf.resolve()), 'elf_sha256': sha(raw),
        'argv_hex': [v.hex() for v in argv], 'environment_hex': [v.hex() for v in environment],
        'sigpipe_ignored': bool(ignored), 'close_fds': closed,
        'exec_failure': str((folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').resolve())}
    dump(folder / 'EXEC-REQUEST.json', spec)
    pipes = []
    read_end = None
    capacity = None
    started = time.perf_counter()
    timed_out = False
    with (folder / 'stdin.bin').open('rb') as inp, (folder / 'stdout.bin').open('wb') as out, \
            (folder / 'stderr.bin').open('wb') as err:
        target_out = out
        target_err = err
        if mode in ('broken-stdout', 'broken-stderr', 'short-stderr'):
            read_end, write_end = os.pipe()
            pipes.extend((read_end, write_end))
            if mode.startswith('broken-'):
                os.close(read_end)
                pipes.remove(read_end)
                read_end = None
            else:
                capacity = fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_GETPIPE_SZ)
                fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_SETFL,
                            fcntl.fcntl(write_end, fcntl.F_GETFL) | os.O_NONBLOCK)
            if mode.endswith('stderr'):
                target_err = write_end
            else:
                target_out = write_end
        command = [sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                   '--raw-exec', str((folder / 'EXEC-REQUEST.json').resolve())]
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=inp, stdout=target_out, stderr=target_err,
                                     start_new_session=True, restore_signals=False)
            try:
                rc = child.wait(timeout=LIMITS['wall'])
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                timed_out = True
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                rc = child.wait(timeout=LIMITS['cleanup'])
            consumed = inp.tell()
            if mode == 'short-stderr':
                os.close(write_end)
                pipes.remove(write_end)
                piece = bytearray()
                while True:
                    data = os.read(read_end, 65536)
                    if not data:
                        break
                    piece.extend(data)
                err.write(piece)
        finally:
            for fd in pipes:
                os.close(fd)
    try:
        os.waitpid(child.pid, os.WNOHANG)
    except ChildProcessError:
        reaped = True
    else:
        reaped = False
    after = elf.read_bytes()
    result = {'command': command, 'payload': str(elf.resolve()), 'returncode': rc,
        'timed_out': timed_out, 'reaped_ECHILD': reaped, 'stdin_consumed': consumed,
        'stdout_hex': (folder / 'stdout.bin').read_bytes().hex(),
        'stderr_hex': (folder / 'stderr.bin').read_bytes().hex(),
        'image_sha256': sha(raw), 'image_after_sha256': sha(after),
        'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started, 'limits': LIMITS,
        'pipe_capacity': capacity, 'preexec_python_ctypes': True,
        'runtime_payload_python_or_ctypes': False,
        'exec_failure': json.loads((folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').read_text())
            if (folder / 'EXEC-FAILURE.json').exists() else None}
    dump(folder / 'OBSERVATION.json', result)
    return result


def reference(program, argv, environment, *, stdin=b'', mode='ordinary', ignored=False,
              short_capacity=None):
    from hepta.hia_linux_process import PROFILE, READ, LinuxStartupSnapshot, LinuxProcessSignal
    from hepta.hia_program_runtime import execute_program, HIAProgramTrap
    consumed = 0
    stdout = []
    stderr = []
    def provider(request):
        nonlocal consumed
        if request.operation == READ:
            if mode == 'closed-stdin':
                return -9, b''
            data = stdin[consumed:consumed + request.count]
            consumed += len(data)
            return len(data), data
        if mode == 'closed-stdout' and request.fd == 1 or mode == 'closed-stderr' and request.fd == 2:
            return -9, b''
        if mode == 'broken-stderr' and request.fd == 2 or mode == 'broken-stdout' and request.fd == 1:
            if ignored:
                return -32, b''
            raise LinuxProcessSignal(int(signal.SIGPIPE))
        accepted = request.count
        if mode == 'short-stderr' and request.fd == 2:
            assert type(short_capacity) is int and 0 < short_capacity < request.count
            accepted = short_capacity
        (stdout if request.fd == 1 else stderr).append(request.write_bytes[:accepted])
        return accepted, b''
    try:
        result = execute_program(program, 'f0', (b'', bytes(1048576), bytes(1048576)),
            profile=PROFILE, linux_process_startup=LinuxStartupSnapshot(argv, environment),
            linux_process_provider=provider, max_steps=10000000)
        rc = result['values'][0] & 255
    except HIAProgramTrap as exc:
        result = exc.report
        rc = -int(signal.SIGILL)
    except LinuxProcessSignal as exc:
        result = exc.report
        rc = -exc.number
    result.update(expected_stdout_hex=b''.join(stdout).hex(),
        expected_stderr_hex=b''.join(stderr).hex(), stdin_consumed=consumed, process_returncode=rc)
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == '--raw-exec'
    raw_exec(sys.argv[2])

def one(operation='linux.argv.copy', args=('v1', 'v3', 'v4', 'v5', 'v6'), *,
        destination=2, index=0, source=1, count=3):
    return ('''hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 selfhost_linux_process
fn f0(v0:readbuf,v1:mutbuf,v2:mutbuf) -> (u32) effects(read,write,trap,linux_startup,linux_io) entry(b0)
block b0(v0:readbuf,v1:mutbuf,v2:mutbuf)
  v3:usize = const() {"value":DESTINATION}
  v4:usize = const() {"value":INDEX}
  v5:usize = const() {"value":SOURCE}
  v6:usize = const() {"value":COUNT}
  v7:RESULTTYPE = OPERATION(ARGS)
  v8:u32 = const() {"value":0}
  ret(v8)
end
'''.replace('DESTINATION', str(destination)).replace('INDEX', str(index))
        .replace('SOURCE', str(source)).replace('COUNT', str(count))
        .replace('RESULTTYPE', 'i64' if operation in IO_OPCODES else 'usize')
        .replace('OPERATION', operation).replace('ARGS', ','.join(args))).encode()

def _tree(raw):
    return ast.parse(raw)


def _function(tree, name):
    matches = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise AssertionError('one exact function required: ' + name)
    return matches[0]


def _fields(node):
    if isinstance(node, ast.AST):
        return (type(node).__name__, tuple((name, _fields(value)) for name, value in ast.iter_fields(node)))
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return tuple(map(_fields, node))
    return (type(node).__name__, node)

        rows = []
        for boundary in ('claim', 'ack', 'observed-store'):
            calls = []; frame = self.effect_frame(calls); issued = frame.pending
            fault = KeyboardInterrupt('actual verification ' + boundary)
            actual_entry = self.image._entry; injected = []
            def entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent):
                command = struct.unpack_from('<Q', ctypes.string_at(work, extent))[0]
                answer = actual_entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent)
                if work is frame.state and command == (2 if boundary == 'claim' else 1):
                    injected.append(command); raise fault
                return answer
            offset = next(item.offset for item in dis.get_instructions(native.ProofContractFrame.service)
                          if item.opname == 'STORE_FAST' and item.argval == 'observed')
            def trace(pyframe, event, arg):
                if pyframe.f_code is native.ProofContractFrame.service.__code__:
                    pyframe.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    if event == 'opcode' and pyframe.f_lasti == offset:
                        injected.append(offset); raise fault
                return trace
            try:
                if boundary == 'observed-store':
                    prior = sys.gettrace(); arming = sys._getframe()
                    old_trace, old_opcodes = arming.f_trace, arming.f_trace_opcodes
                    arming.f_trace = trace; arming.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    sys.settrace(trace)
                    try:
                        with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
                            frame.service(issued)
                    finally:
                        sys.settrace(prior)
                        arming.f_trace, arming.f_trace_opcodes = old_trace, old_opcodes
                else:
                    with patch.object(self.image, '_entry', entry), self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
                        frame.service(issued)
                        if boundary == 'ack':
                            frame.step()
                self.assertIs(caught.exception, fault)
                self.assertEqual(len(injected), 1)
                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                self.assertTrue(frame._uncertain)
                before = bytes(frame.state)
                with self.assertRaises((native.ProofContractUnknown, RuntimeError)):
                    frame.service(issued)
                self.assertEqual(bytes(frame.state), before)
                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                rows.append({'boundary': boundary, 'positive_injections': injected, 'calls': len(calls),
                             'state_sha256': sha256(before).hexdigest(), 'state_prefix': list(struct.unpack_from('<42Q', before))})
            finally:
                frame.close(release=False)
        self.record('actual-handoff-loss', rows)

    def test_independent_vm_complete_protocol_frames_all_sixteen_modes(self):
        from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
        from hepta.hia_program_runtime import _Machine, _Owner, _View
        checked = assemble_program(native.SOURCE.read_bytes())
        function = checked.as_dict()['functions'][0]
        rows = []
        for mode in range(1, 17):
            state = bytearray(self.image.workspace_bytes)
            output = bytearray(b'\xb7' * 2048)
            nonce = 7000 + mode; count = 0
            def call(command, flag=0, error=0, op=0):
                nonlocal count
                sequence = int.from_bytes(state[144:152], 'little')
                struct.pack_into('<6Q', state, 0, command, nonce, sequence,
                                 mode if command == 0 else op if command == 2 else flag, error, self.image.runtime_profile)
                raw = self.image.table
                src = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw + b'\xa5' * 16, len(raw) + 16)
                out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(output) + b'\xb7' * 16, len(output) + 16)
                work = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(state) + b'\xc9' * 16, len(state) + 16)
                actual = self.image._entry(src, len(raw), out, len(output), work, len(state))
                owners = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(output)), _Owner(-3, bytearray(state))]
                expected = _Machine(checked, 10000000, 16 << 20, None, 128).invoke(function,
                    [_View(owners[0], False), _View(owners[1], True), _View(owners[2], True)])[0]
                self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
                self.assertEqual(out.raw[:len(output)], bytes(owners[1].data))
                self.assertEqual(work.raw[:len(state)], bytes(owners[2].data))
                self.assertEqual(src.raw, raw + b'\xa5' * 16)
                self.assertEqual(out.raw[len(output):], b'\xb7' * 16)
                self.assertEqual(work.raw[len(state):], b'\xc9' * 16)
                output[:] = owners[1].data; state[:] = owners[2].data; count += 1
                return actual
            self.assertEqual(call(0), 1)
            self.assertEqual(call(2, op=int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little')), 4)
            # Protocol-only failed first observation. A generated try/except
            # may first request its match-type GLOBAL and EXCEPTION_MATCH;
            # this transport supplies a declared non-match flag. It does not
            # claim an actual provider or exception-matching observation.
            status = call(1, error=1)
            while status == 1:
                self.assertIn(int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little'), (2, 16, 21, 28))
                self.assertEqual(call(2, op=int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little')), 4)
                status = call(1)
                self.assertLess(count, 512)
            self.assertEqual(status, 3)
            status = call(4)
            while status == 1:
                self.assertIn(int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little'), (16, 28))
                self.assertEqual(call(2, op=int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little')), 4)
                status = call(1); self.assertLess(count, 512)
            self.assertEqual(status, 5)
            rows.append({'mode': mode, 'frames': count, 'whole_output_and_workspace_equal': True,
                         'state_sha256': sha256(state).hexdigest(), 'output_sha256': sha256(output).hexdigest()})
        self.record('vm-native-sixteen-mode-error-retirement', rows)

The actual HIA compiler emits program code and the actual HIA entry packer emits

child supervisor; it does not generate x86 code. An explicit caller compiler
digest is an input pin, not matching-cold or whole-system qualification.

def _pinned_digest(value):
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) != 64
            or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)):
        raise ValueError("an exact lowercase compiler SHA-256 is required")
    return value


def _save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def _receipt(receipt, *, provider, source, produced):
    """Bind outer captured inputs to the actual independently returned receipt."""
    if (type(receipt) is not dict
            or receipt.get("artifact_sha256") != _digest(provider)
            or receipt.get("image_sha256") != _digest(provider)
            or receipt.get("input_sha256") != _digest(source)
            or receipt.get("source_sha256") != _digest(source)
            or type(receipt.get("input_bytes")) is not int
            or receipt["input_bytes"] != len(source)
            or receipt.get("produced_sha256") != _digest(produced)
            or type(receipt.get("produced_bytes")) is not int
            or receipt["produced_bytes"] != len(produced)
            or receipt.get("status") != "returned"
            or receipt.get("source_unchanged") is not True):
        raise ValueError("actual compile receipt differs from captured public build inputs")


def _elf_structure(elf, program):
    """Inspect actual HIA output; these checks do not emit any machine bytes."""
    size = (1024 + len(program) + 4095) & -4096
    ident = b"\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01" + bytes(9)
    if (type(elf) is not bytes or not 4096 <= len(elf) <= CAPACITY
            or len(elf) != size
            or struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH", elf) !=
               (ident, 2, 62, 1, 0x400000 + 232, 64, 0, 0, 64, 56, 3, 0, 0, 0)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 64) !=
               (1, 5, 0, 0x400000, 0x400000, size, size, 4096)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 120) !=
               (1, 6, size, 0x600000, 0x600000, 0, 10493952, 4096)
            or struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ", elf, 176) !=
               (0x6474e551, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 16)
            or elf[1024:1024 + len(program)] != program
            or any(elf[1024 + len(program):])):
        raise ValueError("actual HIA packed ELF differs from the fixed entry/segment contract")
    return {"elf_interpreter": False, "writable_executable_segment": False,
            "executable_stack": False, "exact_compiled_program_region": True,
            "file_bytes": size, "entry_offset": 232, "program_offset": 1024,
            "source_extent": 0, "output_extent": CAPACITY,
            "workspace_extent": CAPACITY, "startup_capability_page": 0x600000,
            "output_address": 0x601000, "workspace_address": 0x701000,
            "stack_guard_address": 0x801000, "stack_extent": 8 * CAPACITY,
            "startup_vectors": "kernel original; read-only; ordered raw bytes"}


def build_linux_process_program(program, output, *, profile, compiler,
                              compiler_sha256):
    """Build, never execute, a new ELF under the original 20s/1MiB child limits."""
    require_profile(profile)
    checked = verify_linux_process_program(program)
    source = render_assembly(checked, profile=PROFILE).encode("utf-8")
    compiler_path = Path(compiler)
    expected = _pinned_digest(compiler_sha256)
    compiler_raw = compiler_path.read_bytes()
    if not 0 < len(compiler_raw) <= CAPACITY or _digest(compiler_raw) != expected:
        raise ValueError("caller compiler bytes differ from the explicit pin")
    packer_source = (ROOT / PACKER_SOURCE).read_bytes()
    profile_source = (ROOT / COMPILER_SOURCE).read_bytes()
    # Packer is ordinary, pure Core; its public admission must not acquire I/O.
    packer_checked = assemble_program(packer_source)
    root = Path(output)
    root.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    report = {"schema": "hepta.hia.linux-process-build.v1", "profile": PROFILE,
              "scope": "EXPLICIT_PINNED_DEVELOPMENT_COMPILER",
              "matching_cold": False, "whole": False,
              "public_core_or_code_authority": False,
              "compiler_provenance_qualified": False,
              "author_and_supervisor_python": True,
              "program_sha256": checked.sha256, "source_sha256": _digest(source),
              "compiler_sha256": expected,
              "profile_compiler_source_sha256": _digest(profile_source),
              "packer_source_sha256": _digest(packer_source),
              "packer_core_sha256": packer_checked.sha256,
              "limits": {"compile_seconds": 20, "output_bytes": CAPACITY,
                         "workspace_bytes": CAPACITY}, "stages": []}
    captured = root / "captured-compiler.image.bin"
    captured.write_bytes(compiler_raw)
    captured.chmod(0o400)
    (root / "program.hepta").write_bytes(source)
    (root / "packer.hepta").write_bytes(packer_source)
    try:
        program_image, first = compile_stage(root, "program", captured, source)
        program_raw = program_image.read_bytes()
        _receipt(first, provider=compiler_raw, source=source, produced=program_raw)
        report["stages"].append(first)
        _save(root / "PARTIAL.json", report)
        packer_image, second = compile_stage(root, "packer", captured, packer_source)
        packer_raw = packer_image.read_bytes()
        _receipt(second, provider=compiler_raw, source=packer_source, produced=packer_raw)
        report["stages"].append(second)
        _save(root / "PARTIAL.json", report)
        if len(program_raw) > CAPACITY - 1024:
            raise ValueError("program leaves no room for the fixed ELF entry")
        frame = struct.pack("<QQQQ", PACK_MAGIC, 1, len(program_raw), 0) + program_raw
        elf, third = compile_stage(root, "packed", packer_image, frame,
                                   output_extension=".elf.bin")
        elf_raw = elf.read_bytes()
        _receipt(third, provider=packer_raw, source=frame, produced=elf_raw)
        report["stages"].append(third)
        report["elf_inspection"] = _elf_structure(elf_raw, program_raw)
        # Complete input rechecks are additional to each child's own pins.
        if (compiler_path.read_bytes() != compiler_raw or captured.read_bytes() != compiler_raw
                or (ROOT / PACKER_SOURCE).read_bytes() != packer_source
                or (ROOT / COMPILER_SOURCE).read_bytes() != profile_source
                or verify_linux_process_program(checked).canonical_bytes != checked.canonical_bytes
                or program_image.read_bytes() != program_raw or packer_image.read_bytes() != packer_raw
                or elf.read_bytes() != elf_raw):
            raise ValueError("public build inputs changed")
        destination = root / "program.elf"
        fd = os.open(destination, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
                stream.write(elf_raw)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(fd)
            os.fchmod(fd, 0o500)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        if destination.read_bytes() != elf_raw:
            raise ValueError("ELF publication differs from actual HIA output")
        report.update(status="DEVELOPMENT_BUILD", executable=str(destination.resolve()),
                      executable_bytes=len(elf_raw), executable_sha256=_digest(elf_raw),
                      inputs_unchanged=True, payload_executed=False)
        return report
    except BaseException as exc:
        report.update(status="FAIL", error_type=type(exc).__name__, error=str(exc))
        raise
    finally:
        _save(root / "REPORT.json", report)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True, choices=[PROFILE])
    parser.add_argument("--compiler", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--compiler-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    checked = assemble_program(args.source.read_bytes(), profile=args.profile)
    report = build_linux_process_program(checked, args.output, profile=args.profile,
        compiler=args.compiler, compiler_sha256=args.compiler_sha256)
    print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        return 4294967295
    image = uint(s, 16, 8)
    if image == 0 or image > 1047552 or length(s) != image + 32:

    file_size = (image + 1024 + 4095) & 18446744073709547520
    if file_size > 1048576 or length(o) < file_size:
        return 4294967294
    fill_range(o, 0, file_size, 0)
    headers(o, file_size)
    end = startup(o, 232)

    copy_exact(o, s, 1024, 32, image)

    write(o, 16, 2, 2)
    write(o, 18, 62, 2)
    write(o, 20, 1, 4)
    write(o, 24, 4194536, 8)
    write(o, 32, 64, 8)
    write(o, 52, 64, 2)
    write(o, 54, 56, 2)
    write(o, 56, 3, 2)
    # Immutable file-backed executable text. No interpreter or RWX segment.
    write(o, 64, 1, 4)
    write(o, 68, 5, 4)
    write(o, 80, 4194304, 8)
    write(o, 88, 4194304, 8)
    write(o, 96, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 104, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 112, 4096, 8)
    # Zero BSS: capability page, output, workspace, guard page and 8MiB stack.
    write(o, 120, 1, 4)
    write(o, 124, 6, 4)
    write(o, 128, file_size, 8)
    write(o, 136, 6291456, 8)
    write(o, 144, 6291456, 8)
    write(o, 160, 10493952, 8)
    write(o, 168, 4096, 8)
    write(o, 176, 1685382481, 4)
    write(o, 180, 6, 4)
    write(o, 224, 16, 8)

    at = register32(o, at, 4, 16785408)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xfced31, 3)
    at = register32(o, at, 13, 6291456)

    at = register32(o, at, 6, 0)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xd231, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xd23145, 3)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xc03145, 3)

    at = instruction(o, at, 0x050f, 2)

    at = instruction(o, at, 0x10c47c8d4d, 5)

    string_done = branch(o, at, 132)
    at = string_done + 4
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xc7ff48, 3)

    at = instruction(o, at, 0xdf470f48, 4)
    at = jump(o, at, pointer_loop)

    at = instruction(o, at, 0x305d8949, 4)
    # Seal every original startup page that the indexed primitive can touch.
    # Original RSP and the high end are kernel pointers, not public HIA values.
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xe7894c, 3)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xfffff000e78148, 7)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xde8948, 3)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0x00000fffc68148, 7)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xfffff000e68148, 7)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xfe2948, 3)
    at = register32(o, at, 2, 1)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 10)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0x050f, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xc08548, 3)

    at = register32(o, at, 6, 4096)
    at = register32(o, at, 2, 0)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 10)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0x050f, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xc08548, 3)
    fail3 = branch(o, at, 133)

    at = instruction(o, at, 0x00458949, 4)
    at = register32(o, at, 7, 6291456)
    at = register32(o, at, 6, 4096)
    at = register32(o, at, 2, 1)
    at = register32(o, at, 0, 10)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0x050f, 2)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0xc08548, 3)

    at = register32(o, at, 6, 0)
    at = register32(o, at, 2, 6295552)

    at = register32(o, at, 9, 1048576)

    patch(o, fail2, at)
    patch(o, fail3, at)
    patch(o, fail4, at)

    at = register32(o, at, 0, 60)
    at = instruction(o, at, 0x050f, 2)

def branch(o:mutbuf, at:u64, condition:u64) -> u64:
    store(o, at, 15)
    store(o, at + 1, condition)
    write(o, at + 2, 0, 4)
    return at + 2

def jump(o:mutbuf, at:u64, target:u64) -> u64:
    store(o, at, 233)
    write(o, at + 1, target - at - 5, 4)
    return at + 5

def patch(o:mutbuf, at:u64, target:u64) -> u64:
    write(o, at, target - at - 4, 4)
    return 0

def register32(o:mutbuf, at:u64, reg:u64, value:u64) -> u64:
    if reg >= 8:
        store(o, at, 65)
        at = at + 1
        reg = reg - 8
    store(o, at, 184 + reg)
    write(o, at + 1, value, 4)
    return at + 5

def instruction(o:mutbuf, at:u64, encoding:u64, size:u64) -> u64:
    write(o, at, encoding, size)

        # mov rax,[absolute count]; argv count16, environment count32.
        emit_bytes(o, w, 0x25048b48, 4)
        emit4(o, w, CAP + 16 + family * 16)
        return 0
    load_var(o, w, 0, index, 0)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0x25148b48, 4)
    emit4(o, w, CAP + 16 + family * 16)
    # cmp rax,rdx; jb +2; ud2. Index must precede every pointer read.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0x0b0f0272d03948, 7)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0x25148b48, 4)
    emit4(o, w, CAP + 24 + family * 16)
    # mov rsi,[rdx+rax*8]; xor edx,edx.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xd231c2348b48, 6)
    # Read the kernel NUL terminator inside the sealed startup storage.
    # cmp byte[rsi+rdx],0; je +5; inc rdx; jmp -11.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xff48057400163c80, 8)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xf5ebc2, 3)
    if command == 1:
        emit_bytes(o, w, 0xd08948, 3)
        return 0
    load_var(o, w, 0, d, 0)
    # Source offset <= length, then count <= length-offset, without overflow.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0x0b0f0276d03948, 7)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xc60148c22948, 6)
    load_var(o, w, 0, e, 0)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0x0b0f0276d03948, 7)
    bulk_range_guard(o, w, a, b, e)
    load_var(o, w, 7, a, 0)
    load_var(o, w, 0, b, 0)
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xc70148, 3)
    load_var(o, w, 1, e, 0)
    # cld; rep movsb. Even a zero copy has already checked both boundaries.
    emit_bytes(o, w, 0xa4f3fc, 3)
    load_var(o, w, 0, e, 0)
    return 0
'''.replace('CAP_MAGIC', str(CAP_MAGIC)).replace('CAP +', str(CAP) + ' +').replace('w, CAP)', 'w, ' + str(CAP) + ')')


class ClosedOutputDomain(ast.NodeTransformer):
    """Only private profile232 can be 0 or 4 after explicit admission.

    No other call/value is constant-folded. Keeping the before/after expressions
    and the complete reachable graph makes this small projection reviewable.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self.replacements = []

    def visit_Compare(self, node):
        node = self.generic_visit(node)
        if (len(node.ops) == 1 and len(node.comparators) == 1
                and isinstance(node.left, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.left.func, ast.Name)
                and node.left.func.id == 'byte'
                and ast.dump(node.left, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(
                    ast.parse('byte(w,232)', mode='eval').body, include_attributes=False)
                and isinstance(node.comparators[0], ast.Constant)
                and node.comparators[0].value in (1, 2)
                and isinstance(node.ops[0], (ast.Eq, ast.NotEq))):
            value = isinstance(node.ops[0], ast.NotEq)
            self.replacements.append({'before': ast.unparse(node), 'after': value,
                                      'line': node.lineno})
            return ast.copy_location(ast.Constant(value=value), node)
        return node

    def visit_BoolOp(self, node):
        node = self.generic_visit(node)
        if all(isinstance(x, ast.Constant) and type(x.value) is bool for x in node.values):
            return ast.copy_location(ast.Constant(value=(all if isinstance(node.op, ast.And) else any)(
                x.value for x in node.values)), node)
        # A leading constant can eliminate only the original short-circuit tail.
        if isinstance(node.values[0], ast.Constant) and type(node.values[0].value) is bool:
            first = node.values[0].value
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or) and first or isinstance(node.op, ast.And) and not first:
                return ast.copy_location(ast.Constant(value=first), node)
            if len(node.values) == 2:
                return node.values[1]
            node.values = node.values[1:]
        return node

    def visit_If(self, node):
        node = self.generic_visit(node)
        if isinstance(node.test, ast.Constant) and type(node.test.value) is bool:
            return node.body if node.test.value else node.orelse
        return node

    def visit_FunctionDef(self, node):
        node = self.generic_visit(node)
        # The selected owned-instruction rejection ends its original function.
        for index, statement in enumerate(node.body):
            if isinstance(statement, ast.Return):
                node.body = node.body[:index + 1]
                break
        return node


def extension_source():
    words = dict(original.W)
    for name in (PROFILE, IO_EFFECT, STARTUP_EFFECT, *IO, *STARTUP):
        assert name not in words
        words[name] = 300 + len(words)
    source = original.SOURCE
    start = source.index('        if get(w, 8) == @selfhost_elf@:')
    stop = source.index('        expect(s, w, 10)\n        read_exports(s, w)', start)
    before = source[start:stop]
    after = '''        if get(w, 8) == @selfhost_elf@ or get(w, 8) == @selfhost_exec@:
            fail(w, 93)
            return 4294967295
        if get(w, 8) == @selfhost_linux_process@:
            put(w, 232, 4)
        next_token(s, w)
'''
    source = strict(source, before, after)
    source = strict(source, '        read_exports(s, w)\n', '''        put(w, 640, 0)
        put(w, 648, 0)
        if get(w, 8) == @exports@:
            fail(w, 93)
            return 4294967295
''')
    source = strict(source, '        validate_exports(s, w)\n', '')
    source = strict(source, '''        flag = 1
        if token != @alloc@:
            if token < @read@ or token > @trap@:
                return fail(w, 65)
            flag = 2 << (token - @read@)
''', '''        flag = 1
        if token == @linux_io@ or token == @linux_startup@:
            if get(w, 232) != 4:
                return fail(w, 65)
            flag = 16 << (token - @linux_io@)
        else:
            if token != @alloc@:
                if token < @read@ or token > @trap@:
                    return fail(w, 65)
                flag = 2 << (token - @read@)
''')
    source = strict(source, 'def instruction_effects(op:u64) -> u64:\n', '''def instruction_effects(op:u64) -> u64:
    if op == @linux.stdin.read@:
        return 28
    if op == @linux.stdout.write@ or op == @linux.stderr.write@:
        return 26
    if op >= @linux.argv.count@ and op <= @linux.env.copy@:
        if op >= @linux.argv.copy@:
            return 46
        return 42
''')
    source = strict(source, 'def operation_dispatch(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:\n', '''def operation_dispatch(o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf, op:u64, n:u64, a:u64, b:u64, at:u64, bt:u64, t:u64) -> u64:
    if op >= @linux.stdin.read@ and op <= @linux.stderr.write@:
        return process_stdio(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
    if op >= @linux.argv.count@ and op <= @linux.env.copy@:
        return process_startup(o, w, op, n, a, b, at, bt, t)
''')
    source += HELPERS
    globals_ = dict(vars(original)); globals_['SOURCE'] = source; globals_['W'] = words
    expanded = types.FunctionType(original.source_program.__code__, globals_)()
    tree = ast.parse(expanded)
    transform = ClosedOutputDomain()
    tree = transform.visit(tree)
    ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
    functions = {n.name: n for n in tree.body}
    calls = {name: sorted({c.func.id for c in ast.walk(fn) if isinstance(c, ast.Call)
             and isinstance(c.func, ast.Name) and c.func.id in functions}) for name, fn in functions.items()}
    reached = {'compile'}
    while True:
        next_ = reached | {callee for name in reached for callee in calls[name]}
        if next_ == reached:
            break
        reached = next_
    omitted = sorted(set(functions) - reached)
    tree.body = [fn for fn in tree.body if fn.name in reached]
    # No surviving function can set profile232 to a legacy output mode.
    writes = [n for fn in tree.body for n in ast.walk(fn) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
              and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id in ('put', 'store')
              and len(n.args) == 3 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant) and n.args[1].value == 232]
    assert len(writes) == 1 and ast.literal_eval(writes[0].args[2]) == 4
    evidence = {'rejected_before_functions': ['selfhost_elf', 'selfhost_exec', 'exports'],
                'profile_header_clear_each_pass': 'fill_range(w, 0, 256, 0)',
                'only_profile_write': ast.unparse(writes[0]), 'profile_values': [0, 4],
                'folded_comparisons': transform.replacements, 'call_graph': calls,
                'retained_functions': [n.name for n in tree.body], 'unreachable_functions': omitted,
                'admission_before': before, 'admission_after': after}
    return ast.unparse(tree) + '\n', words, evidence


def generated():
    text, _, _ = extension_source()
    return build(text, True)[0]


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--report', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    text, words, projection = extension_source()
    rendered, author, report = build(text, True)
    target = ROOT / 'examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost_linux_process.hepta'
    if args.check:
        if target.read_text() != rendered:
            raise SystemExit('Linux process compiler source differs')
    else:
        target.write_text(rendered)
    report.update(projection=projection, profile=PROFILE, words=words,
                  source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(rendered.encode()).hexdigest(),
                  source_bytes=len(rendered.encode()), matching_cold=False, whole=False)
    if args.report:
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ('counts','source_sha256','source_bytes','matching_cold','whole')}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
